text: mode user An AUTOSAR SW-C or AUTOSAR Basic Software Module that depends on modes is called a mode user. The dependency can occur through a SwcModeSwitchEvent/BswModeSwitchEvent, a ModeAccessPoint for a provided/required mode switch port, or a accessedModeGroup for a providedModeGroup/requiredModeGroup ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype. See also section 4.4.1.
